C0818.title: Baidu Employee Jin Sentenced for Deliberately Deleting and Altering Company Database After Project Transfer
C0818.summary: In June 2022, a 1996-born programmer at Baidu, surnamed Jin, became dissatisfied with his department head after his project was reassigned to another colleague. He repeatedly deleted and modified data within the company's visualization project database, rendering the system unable to generate quality assessment data and causing serious consequences.
